summary: Iteration 11 – Trading Only (Premium) feed. BACKEND: 17/17 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_trading_only.py against the live preview API. Verified end-to-end: (a) demo login as demo_trader; POST /api/posts {text:'TEST_iter11 prop firm question', space:'trading', mentions:[]} → 201 with space='trading' and author.username='demo_trader' (normal identity, no Mingle alias). (b) Space isolation – GET /posts?space=trading contains it; GET /posts (scope=all AND scope=following, default space=main) does NOT; GET /users/{demo_id}/posts does NOT (routes_posts.MAIN_SPACE = {space: {$nin: [mingle, trading]}}); GET /posts/{id} works for demo (200). (c) Engagement parity with main – POST /posts/{id}/react {reaction:'🔥'} → my_reaction=🔥, POST /posts/{id}/comments with mentions=[demo_id] and @demo_trader in text → 201 with mentions=[demo_id] and mentioned_users[0].username='demo_trader' (normal mention behaviour). POST /share → shares_count>=1. POST /bookmark → saved=true, GET /me/saved includes trading post (private saved list allowed). (d) Regression – POST /posts without space → 201 with space='main'. (e) Gating – fresh /auth/signup free-tier user gets 402 on GET /posts?space=trading, POST /posts {space:'trading'}, and GET /posts/{trading_id}; after POST /membership/activate {plan:'monthly'} → 200, all three succeed. GET /membership.features has {key:'trading_only', available:true, unlocked:true}. (f) Notifications – fresh premium reacts 🔥 and comments on demo's trading post; demo GET /notifications lists both with actor.username set (normal, non-Mingle), and no notification carries mingle=true. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x844, demo login): Premium tab renders premium-card-trading_only with 'Unlocked' badge (feature.unlocked=true); tapping premium-card-trading_only-press navigates to /trading and mounts trading-only-screen with header 'TRADING ONLY', 'The conversation behind the charts.', and the full description 'A members-only space for real conversations about strategies, prop firms, platforms, tools, trading psychology, resources, lessons learned and everything trading.' – all three header phrases confirmed in DOM. FAB trading-compose-button opens create-post-screen with title 'New Trading Only post' (isTrading via useLocalSearchParams.space==='trading'); typing 'TEST_iter11_ui_ea35d4 chart share' + create-submit-button posts, toast 'Posted to Trading Only', router.replace('/trading') lands on Trading Only feed with the new post at top rendered by PostCard (Demo Trader / @demo_trader / normal reactions/comment/share/save). Confirmed: same post NOT present in Home tab feed. Opening the Create tab directly (no params) shows title 'New post' – the setParams({space:''}) clear works. Posting from that Create tab lands the post on the main feed (verified TEST_iter11_ui_main_bf5996 appears at top of Home '/'). Cleanup: deleted both UI-created posts (trading and main) via DELETE /api/posts/{id} as demo (both 200). Pytest backend suite auto-cleans its own CREATED_POSTS in teardown_module.

Trading posts never surface via main-feed queries; saved list also excludes mingle explicitly. routes_posts./me/saved excludes only mingle ({"space": {"$ne": "mingle"}}) so private saved list can include trading posts. Matches spec 'private saved list is allowed'. Verified test_10.

routes_activity.has_access('trading_only', ...) resolves via membership feature registry – returns True for active premium. Verified test_15 (after activate) and test_16 (features payload has available=true, unlocked=true).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 (Trading Only). Backend contract summary: (1) POST /api/posts accepts space:'main'|'trading' (default 'main'). Trading requires has_access(user,'trading_only') else 402. (2) GET /api/posts?space=trading is the Trading Only feed; scope=all|following applies within that space. (3) Main-feed queries (default space=main, /users/{id}/posts, /me/saved) exclude both 'mingle' and 'trading' via routes_posts.MAIN_SPACE. (4) All reactions/comments/shares/bookmarks/notifications on trading posts use NORMAL identity (author_summary), never Mingle. Notification records do not carry mingle=true. (5) Fresh premium activation is POST /api/membership/activate {plan:'monthly'}. (6) /api/membership.features['trading_only'] has {available:true, unlocked:true} for premium. Frontend testIDs verified: tab-premium, premium-card-trading_only, premium-card-trading_only-press, trading-only-screen, trading-back-button, trading-search-button, trading-compose-button, trading-empty-cta, trading-feed-list, create-post-screen, create-text-input, create-submit-button, premium-paywall, paywall-activate-button. The Create-tab title correctly reverts to 'New post' after a trading submit because create.tsx line 32 calls router.setParams({space:''}) before router.replace('/trading'). Login is via landing 'Log in' link → login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Backend returns access_token (not 'token'). /api/auth/me is the current-user endpoint (NOT /api/me – that path 405s).
rca_of_issue: No new bugs surfaced. All spec bullets pass. The single UI paywall step could not be exercised via a token-injection shortcut (fresh signup → localStorage.setItem then navigate to /trading returned the landing screen, likely because the app's auth bootstrap gates on an onboarding flag rather than a raw token). The paywall wiring is nonetheless confirmed by code inspection (trading/index.tsx line 38-41 renders <PremiumPaywall featureKey="trading_only" title="Trading Only" lead="The conversation behind the charts. A members-only space for real conversations…" />) and by the backend 402 gating tests (test_12–test_15). If a future iteration needs a full-UI paywall verification, drive it through the actual signup UI (Create account flow) rather than injecting a token.
